shellCommands.command: git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && ls
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30
timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor peerDependenciesMeta 2>&1; timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 dependencies | head -60

timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 @gravity-ui/components@^4.10.0 @diplodoc/transform@^4.43.0 markdown-it@^13.0.0 katex@^0.16.9 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension@^0.2.1 @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15
timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/components@">=4.10.0 <4.25" peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"@gravity-ui/components@|uikit'

timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tr -d ' \n' | grep -o '"4\.2[0-9][^"]*"' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; for v in 4.22.0 4.23.0 4.24.0; do echo $v $(timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null); done

timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 @diplodoc/transform@^4.43.0 markdown-it@^13.0.0 katex@^0.16.9 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension@^0.2.1 @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -A12 '"dependencies"' package.json

sed -i 's#"@gravity-ui/components": "^4.23.1"#"@gravity-ui/components": "~4.23.1"#; s#"@gravity-ui/markdown-editor": "^15.49.0"#"@gravity-ui/markdown-editor": "15.49.0"#' package.json && D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; cat $D/package.json | grep -A30 '"exports"' | head -40; ls $D/build; sed -n 1,200p $D/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts 2>/dev/null

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; cat $D/bundle/types.d.ts | head -150; cat $D/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build; ls -R $D/docs | head -40; cat $D/docs/guides/*getting-started* 2>/dev/null | head -150
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs; cat $D/INDEX.md | head -80; cat $D/guides/how-to-add-preview.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; sed -n 150,260p $D/bundle/types.d.ts; cat $D/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts | head -80; grep -n "export" $D/index.d.ts $D/bundle/index.d.ts $D/view/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; cat $D/view/components/index.d.ts; ls $D/view/components/YfmHtml; cat $D/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.d.ts; cat $D/bundle/events.d.ts; cat $D/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "placeholder" -i $D/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; cat $D/configure.d.ts; grep -rn "html" $D/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.js | head; grep -n "export" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "needToSanitizeHtml\|allowHTML" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts | head
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|✓ built" ; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 400 npm i playwright@1.64.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 400 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /tmp/pw && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium-headless-shell 2>&1 | tail -2; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright

grep -n "process" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js | head; grep -rn "require('./utilsFS')\|utilsFS" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/*.js | head -5; grep -n "require(\"fs\")\|require('fs')\|fs\." node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/utilsFS.js | head
mv /tmp/pwscripts/vitest.config.ts src/__tmp__/vitest.config.ts && timeout 200 npx vitest run -c src/__tmp__/vitest.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s*$" | head -60
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/
sed -i '40s/^export function App() {$/function NoteForm() {/' src/App.tsx && sed -n 25,75p src/App.tsx

find node_modules -type d -name "prosemirror-*" -path "*node_modules/prosemirror-*" | grep -v "^node_modules/prosemirror-[a-z-]*$" | head; find node_modules -name package.json -path "*prosemirror-view/package.json" -o -name package.json -path "*prosemirror-state/package.json" | xargs grep -H '"version"'

sed -i 's#inline: \[/@gravity-ui/, /@diplodoc/\]#inline: true#' src/__tmp__/vitest.config.ts && timeout 250 npx vitest run -c src/__tmp__/vitest.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s*$" | grep -v "^\s*at " | head -40

for p in prosemirror-autocomplete prosemirror-codemark prosemirror-state; do echo "== $p"; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/$p/package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,exports:p.exports}))"; done; ls dist/assets; grep -o "Adding different instances of a keyed plugin" dist/assets/*.js | wc -l; grep -c "class PluginKey\|function PluginKey" dist/assets/index-*.js

pkill -f "vite --port 5179"; rm -rf src/__tmp__ dist /tmp/pwscripts; timeout 200 npm prune >/dev/null 2>&1; ls node_modules/jsdom 2>&1 | head -1; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|✓ built"; rm -rf dist; git status --short

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"vite --port 5179"*) kill ${p#/proc/} && echo killed ${p#/proc/};; esac; done; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git diff package.json
git diff package.json
